title: Keyturn Host Protection Plan: Further Repair Cost Added to an Appraised Claim
content:
Cost found after a loss has been appraised is added to the claim that settled it rather than opened as a fresh claim. Further cost is not added to a claim before the cover the loss was settled under stands in force again. The addition is made against the appraised claim on the Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment it belongs to.

### Situation of use and capability

`record_repair_supplement_1a6beabe` writes a supplement record against the named appraised claim carrying the further cost accepted, how it was evidenced and the supplementary invoice reference, and raises the enrolment's balance owed to the host by that figure. The host can afterwards see the supplement against the claim and the higher amount owed to them.

### How it is invoked

The tool is unlocked and then called by the desk agent, who works out the further cost accepted and passes it in.

### Parameters

- `enrollment_id` — the reference number of the host protection enrolment the claim is made under, read from the enrolment record retrieved for this host.
- `source_claim_id` — the reference number of the appraised claim record the further cost is added to, read from the claim records standing on that enrolment.
- `booking_id` — the reference number of the trip booking the loss happened on, read from the claim record the supplement is added to.
- `damage_category` — the kind of loss the further cost belongs to, one of `exterior_body`, `interior`, `glass`, `tyres_wheels`, `mechanical`, `theft_total_loss`, `missing_equipment` and `third_party_property`.
- `appraisal_channel` — how the further cost was evidenced, one of `photo_estimate` (from further photographs alone), `in_person_adjuster` (by an adjuster who re-inspected the vehicle), `repair_shop_invoice` (by a supplementary invoice from the repairing shop) and `total_loss_valuation` (by a fresh write-off valuation of the vehicle).
- `settlement_reference` — the supplementary invoice reference the host reads out, copied character for character from what the host says, keeping the original wording, digits, letter case and punctuation, with nothing translated, normalised, summarised, added or removed.
- `supplement_amount` — the further cost accepted and added to what is owed to the host, in USD, 2 decimal places, signed, passed as a positive figure rounded half-up to the cent.

### Return

A confirmation line in plain text carrying the reference number of the supplement record, the claim it adds to, the further cost accepted in USD to the cent and the enrolment's new balance owed to the host. Receiving that line means the supplement stands and the money is booked as owed; no other output is produced.
